 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Order

This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.66/2016 PS Sarita Vihar under sections 498A/406/34 IPC on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes with the facilitation of the Counseling Cell, Family Court, Saket on 12th January, 2017.

2. As per the settlement, a total amount of Rs.15 lacs has to be paid to respondent no.2 out of which a sum of Rs.10 lacs has already been paid and divorce by mutual consent has since been obtained vide decree dated 24th May, 2018.
However, the balance sum of Rs.5 lacs which is to be paid to respondent no.2 is still pending as the respondent no.2 is not appearing.
3. The matter has been listed since 2019 for the appearance of respondent no.2 and even Legal Aid counsel has also been provided to her.

It is however submitted by Ms. Manika Tripathy, Advocate that neither is she appearing in the Court despite being present in the court complex on a couple of occasions nor is she signing the vakalatnama.

This fact has also been recorded in previous order dated 31st January, 2023, for which reason this Court had issued court notice to respondent no.2.
4.
Same situation has apparently arisen today.

Respondent no.2 is not present despite the fact that the IO also had tried to contact respondent no.2 and her family but she has chosen not to appear to receive the balance amount of Rs.5 lacs towards culmination of the settlement which has been duly complied with, as is evident from the records.
It would, therefore, not be just and fair to linger the quashing of the petition and FIR.

sentences.text: In these peculiar facts and circumstances, it is accordingly directed that the petitioner shall deposit the balance sum of Rs.5 lacs in the name of Registrar General of this Court, in form of interest bearing FDR.
Respondent no.2 will be entitled to withdraw this amount, as and when desired, by moving an application in that regard before this Court.

6. In view of the above facts, it would not be prudent to continue with the proceedings under the FIR and therefore, FIR No.66/2016 PS Sarita Vihar under sections 498A/406/34 IPC and consequent proceedings emanating therefrom are hereby quashed subject to deposit of Rs.5 lacs by the petitioner in the Registry within a period of 10 days.

7. An affidavit of compliance be also filed by the petitioner on record of this Court with copy to the Ld. APP and the IO.
8.
Petition stands disposed of with above directions.
9. Pending applications, if any, are disposed of as infructuous.
10. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
